name: My Dream Sport Dating Simulator
source: Do you like Sports? Do you really, really like sports? Enough to date one of them? No?... Well.. this is awkward. If you change your mind, oh boy we have the game for you. Become the next big sport, live your best school life, and romance up to seven other sports in this crazy visual novel.
translation: 你喜欢运动吗？非常、非常喜欢吗？喜欢到愿意和一项运动谈恋爱？不愿意？……呃，这就尴尬了。要是你改了主意，我们可有款再适合你不过的游戏。在这部疯狂的视觉小说中，成为下一颗运动新星，尽情享受校园生活，与多达七位运动项目化身的角色展开恋情。
